title: MIST labeled fault-case (C2 benchmark) — rev 2
description: One labeled case in the MIST open-source benchmark of masked-downstream / acked-but-lost data-integrity faults. REV 2: brought into lockstep with debug/a-main/c2c3/c2-freeze.md (step-1 re-freeze, R1-R8). A case records the target write, the typed durable read-back, the fault + its clean twin, the ground-truth label, per-oracle EXPECTED verdicts (baseline columns deterministic; mist_* columns are TARGETS measured at eval, never ground truth), and the visibility axes (trace + ack-content). An oracle is CORRECT on a case iff its actual verdict matches its oracle_expectation entry, which for baseline columns equals (verdict==flag)==(label==positive). Supersedes schema v0.1.0 (see README migration map).

stratum.description: 1 = positive by construction (injected/replicated/vendor/natural). 2 = benign trap (label=negative, by-docs). 3 = adjudicated wild (label by raters; may be underspecified).

capture_status.description: specified = designed, label known, traces/read-back not yet recorded. captured = control/fault traces + read-back recorded on a live deploy.

fault_class.description: Surface phenomenon (NOT the verdict). none = clean control / benign.

readback_shape.description: R1d/§8: OPTIONAL structured render-shape of the durable read-back, so the shape-polarity census (SUT x shape x provenance) is mechanically computable rather than free-text. Populated on NEGATIVES (the benign census): present-landed = clean write lands (control/clean-twin); eventual-present = absent at cap then heals PRESENT at re-probe (bounded eventual consistency; MIST single-shot timeout FPs by construction); reject-no-delta = by-design 2xx no-persist/no-change rendering present-unchanged or zero-delta, disambiguated by a body-tell (status:0) OR a same-with-same norm (dedupe / no-op-modify); reject-absent-empty = fresh-key soft-reject that renders EMPTY like a genuine loss (the presence-defuser shape; structurally near-unreachable per r1d-phase0-findings.md — 0 today, enum reserved); degraded-present = designed graceful degradation / optional-dependency-down 2xx (swallowed_downstream_error). POSITIVES omit this field — their shape is fault_class-derived (acknowledged_lost_write=absent-lost; the parent-landed/child-lost meshsever=partial-aggregate-loss).

image_digest.description: sha256:...; the label is bound to this digest (label.version_validity).

health_precondition.description: Pre-flight checklist path (pods Ready, endpoints 200, mesh/broker state).

readback.description: R4/B-B4: TYPED, oracle-agnostic durable observable. Replaces the old prose observable + optional readback_endpoint.

locator.description: endpoint path | SQL | queue name | span selector | null.

mist_bindable.description: Can MIST's oracle bind this modality? sql-probe / none-durable may be false.

mechanism.description: R1: the fault-MECHANISM diversity class (what the >=4-per-write-path-SUT floor counts). flag = app/runtime/vendor feature toggle; dependency-down = DB/backing-store kill; none = clean/benign. An input-driven variant is a STIMULUS (stimulus.workload_variant), NOT a mechanism, and does NOT count toward diversity.

injection_method.description: HOW the mechanism is produced (was injection.mechanism in v0.1.0). natural = an unmodified designed-degradation path (no injection).

present.description: Every S1 case MUST have one. The oracle's negative test: not-firing => TN, firing => FP.

workload_variant.description: R1: input-driven variants live here (e.g. bogus-user-id), not as a mechanism.

ack_content_visibility.description: R8/C-A2: does the 2xx ack itself carry a machine-readable tell? Non-clean => tell-bearing => segregated from the primary discriminating positive denominator.

trace_visibility.description: B-M5: by-construction invisibility (fabricated-ack/normal span) is kept separate from tooling-contingent (un-instrumented, e.g. TeaStore-Kieker-exclude).

oracle_mode.description: U7: which MIST mode produced this case's verdict. observe = product single-leg; paired = eval harness.

mist_commit.description: ONE frozen study-wide commit; IDENTICAL across every case. Pinned at the END of the 1.9 UX wave (criteria incl. W0-W6; QuiescenceGate->verdict mapping frozen at the pin).

mist_authoring.description: U7: MIST's side of the authoring-cost symmetry. Unit = minutes per bound endpoint (same unit as comparator authoring_cost).

label.description: positive == rubric 'genuine'; negative == 'benign'; underspecified is STRATUM-3 ONLY (norm not derivable from docs/spec/source) and is excluded from the primary precision denominator.

rationale.description: Observation (from the case's presented state, admissible) + the NORM (from docs/spec/source only) per rubric.md. Traces/tool-output are NOT the source of the norm.

doc_citation.description: by-docs labels cite the doc version.

oracle_expectation.description: Per-oracle EXPECTED verdict. Baseline columns are deterministic by construction; mist_* columns are TARGETS measured at eval (never ground truth). body_marker_oracle flags iff oracle_eval.ack_content_visibility != success-shaped-clean.

kappa.description: S3-only kappa is the PRIMARY reliability statistic (R7).
